study.question: Does preserving action alignment in either the raw target-match summary or its rescaled/gated copy rescue the click-AUC loss from rotating both, with task-specific readout and observed direct action pools fixed?
study.hypothesis: Observation: the inherited best has click AUC 0.666753547526167 versus DIN 0.6555440824200336. The historical aligned action-value reference g1-r0029-summary_align_task scored 0.6662444304756373; rotating all summary actions scored 0.6631998062685012. In r0030, rotating only match rows scored 0.6637318310781741, versus 0.665886846280108 when only ordinal rows were rotated. The corresponding shared-readout values were 0.6619746842088738 and 0.6643709148563283. These single-seed, cross-source observations motivate, but do not establish, match-alignment utility or task-conditioning interaction. Mechanism hypothesis: row 0 is a raw centered target-match/action association, while row 4 is a positive rescaling of that same direction under additional support gates. A surviving aligned copy may retain most of the usable association when the other copy is rotated; disrupting both should be more harmful than disrupting either alone. Code inspection, not a new measured result, establishes that the two coefficients share direction on active fifth support. The proposed experiment tests the trained nonlinear readout response to this redundancy. No novel architecture or priority claim is made.

nearest_work.difference: Closest local implementation. Extend only its action-alignment selector to raw row 0 and rescaled/gated row 4 separately. Preserve the existing both/none endpoints and train four fresh cells; no external architecture is adopted.

study.proposed_difference: A fresh 2x2 factorial of action alignment in summary row 0 (aligned/rotated) and summary row 4 (aligned/rotated), with task-specific routing fixed in all four cells. candidate.py rotates row 0 alone; aligned_match.py rotates neither; rotated_scaled_match.py rotates row 4 alone; rotated_both_match.py rotates both. All cells use summary_action_alignment=rotated so the same gather executes, and select aligned ordinal action rows 1/2/3. The two additional selector tuples change no learned shape or coefficient construction. The both-rotated fresh endpoint has the exact inherited match selector. This deliberately prioritizes a complete within-round component factorial over adding shared routing without fresh endpoints. A later authorized four-cell shared-readout suite would be required to test routing interaction.
predictions: Let A00=align_match_task, A10=rotate_raw_match_task, A01=rotate_scaled_match_task, A11=rotate_both_match_task full-population validation click AUC. Predict A00>A11 and that A01 is closer to A00 than A11 is: leaving raw association aligned should rescue utility.

Predict partial rescue for A10 relative to A11 on histories where fifth support is active. Overall A10 may recover less than A01 because the aligned fifth copy is gated and differently scaled. These are directional predictions, not a forecast of a new incumbent.

Under redundant-copy rescue, expect I=A11-A10-A01+A00<0. Report both simple effects A00-A10, A01-A11 (raw alignment conditional on fifth state), and A00-A01, A10-A11 (fifth alignment conditional on raw state). Do not infer mechanism from one favorable cell.

At a common parameter state only selected match-action coordinates may differ; ordinal action, all item summaries, scorer inputs, direct pools, masks, counts, support gates and compression assignments must agree. First compare nonzero residual final layers as zero initialization otherwise hides intervention effects.

Use full validation click AUC as primary, all four task AUC/Logloss and auxiliary mean AUC separately. Measure parameters, allocated GPU/wall seconds, examples, peak memory, throughput and batch p50/p95 latency. Expected inherited parameter counts 32129765/31793216/336549 total/embedding/dense are receipt estimates, not local measurements.

Optional authorized diagnostics: fixed inherited history-length bins plus fifth-gate active/inactive and actual rotation-changed/unchanged bins, defined from allowed inputs before scoring. Report sample/positive/negative counts and insufficient slices. Slice score differences after independent training are exploratory; empty histories need not have equal predictions after weights diverge.
falsifiers: Failure of finite forward/backward, target-action or invalid-history invariance, task-mask preservation, state/initializer parity, selector localization or inherited auxiliary gradient ownership invalidates attribution. Missing dynamic checks leave attribution unverified; static checks alone are insufficient.

If fresh A00 and A11 do not reproduce a meaningful ordered contrast, do not attribute the old cross-round gap to these match summaries. Null or opposite single-copy rescue weakens the redundancy explanation and points to optimization, scale/support, or joint representation effects.

If A10 and A01 lose as much as A11, surviving aligned information alone is not sufficient under this frozen recipe; this does not refute feedback utility. If only one single-copy cell recovers, distinguish gate coverage and scale from independent information before explaining the difference.

No repeated support without additional paired seeds through an authorized host phase. No evidence here establishes total action removal, a task-conditioning interaction, transfer beyond official_offline visibility, or new architecture novelty.
alternative_explanations: This is a conditional summary alignment intervention: direct action pools and action-derived historical task masks remain informative. It cannot measure total historical feedback utility or production causality.

Raw and scaled/gated match summaries are input-dependent copies in exact arithmetic only where the fifth support is active. The fifth has additional occupancy/degeneracy gates, and BF16 coefficient casting/contraction introduces rounding. Their distinct scales/support and nonlinear readout optimization remain possible explanations.

Rotation preserves each valid block action multiset but not action-to-item alignment or the numerical distribution of match summaries. A loss can reflect representation usability/optimization as well as lost association.

A single frozen seed is preliminary. Identical-seed fresh endpoint execution is a reproducibility check, not independent mechanism repetition. No routing interaction can be estimated from this task-only suite.
